name: AdGuard Home clients
description: Reads what AdGuard Home knows about your devices: the DHCP leases and static leases (MAC address, IP address, host name) and the clients you named in AdGuard (with a MAC address among their identifiers), including the device type and operating system from AdGuard's tags (device_tv, os_android ...). Netlens matches them by MAC address and uses the names and types. Read-only. (To register names in AdGuard Home, use the AdGuard Home DNS plugin.)
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
